name: recsys_reflection
description: Structured diagnosis of the last training iteration's result. Forces the agent to name a real recsys phenomenon with evidence, rather than giving vague free-text reflection.

recsys_phenomenon_identified.description: The named phenomenon best explaining this iteration's result. Use 'other' only if none of the above fit, and explain in notes.

evidence.description: The specific metric evidence supporting this diagnosis, e.g. 'GAUC +0.006, nDCG@5 -0.011, primary 0.601 vs popularity-only anchor 0.5715'. Must reference actual GAUC/nDCG@5/primary numbers from this run, anchored against the known reference points (random=0.4753, popularity=0.5715, baseline=0.5946, ceiling=0.8645) where relevant — not general reasoning.

confidence.description: How confident the diagnosis is given the evidence available.

notes.description: Free text. Required and must explain the phenomenon if 'other' or 'no_clear_phenomenon' was selected. Optional otherwise.

next_action.description: The specific next move to try from the trick menu, and why it follows from this diagnosis.

next_action_category.description: Which part of the trick menu the next action pulls from.
